hooks.command: echo '💡 Reminder: pnpm type-check && pnpm test after completing changes'

cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && if ! git diff --quiet HEAD -- '*.ts' '*.tsx' 2>/dev/null; then echo '🔍 Running pnpm type-check (TS files changed)...' >&2; pnpm type-check 2>&1 | tail -40 || { echo '❌ Type check failed — fix errors before finishing.' >&2; exit 2; }; fi
